about: Overrides: decided values of templates that imports must not lose (step 2.7, src/avail/overrides.ts). Accepted proposals (export:overrides writes them from the database) and the port decisions of AVAIL engineers (standard v0.11, R6). import:catalog, fill:catalog-ports and normalize:library apply them over the catalog and the database. A template matches by templateId, manufacturer + modelNumber or label; a port by its label as it was (port), its new label or portId. kind field: value replaces the field (null removes it); kind port: op set replaces the listed fields, add adds the port, remove drops it. base: the value before the decision (absent = unknown).
